name: banner
title: Banner
description: Promotes a next step, a guide or a new feature with a line of copy and one action, on a mesh or plain background.

props.name: action
props.description: One action, usually `<Button variant="secondary">`. Stretches across a sidebar banner.

props.name: tone
props.description: `primary`: action/primary/bg with action/primary/fg text; its mesh glows lighter on top.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: Now and then a soft band of light crosses the banner (off under reduced motion).

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button. Defaults to the `dismiss` label.
